Coram : G.S. SINGHVI*, V. GOPALA GOWDA
14 S.C.R. 848 BRIHANMUMBAI MAHANAGARPALIKA AND ANOTHER v. WILLINGDON SPORTS CLUB AND OTHERS (Civil Appeal No. 5840 of 2013) NOVEMBER 18, 2013 [G.S. SINGHVI AND V. GOPALA GOWDA, JJ.i Mumbai Municipal Corporation Act, 1888 - s.394(1)(e) rlw. Part IV Schedule M and s. 3(ff) - Licence under - Need c to take licence as it is not covered under definition of 'eating house' u/s.3(ff) - On appeal, held: Though the primary D activity of the club is to provide sports facilities, but supply of food was an integral part of such activity - Even though profit may not be motto of catering
Decision Date : 18-11-2013 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 5840/2013 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
